answer: A genuinely independent QA package on existing C0 can be a candidate empty context for normal Email OTP; no Auth protocol requires Google OAuth or a new native compile. This does not prove safely reusing/re-signing0e. Native artifact owner must establish actual binary/config/signing/container isolation; changing CFBundleIdentifier alone is insufficient.

email.protocol: POST /auth/v1/otp {email,create_user}; POST /auth/v1/verify {email,token,type:email} -> normal provisional Session -> existing qualified install
email.note: No redirectTo/emailRedirectTo/AuthSession callback in this Email path; nonce belongs to separate Google ID-token flow. No new OAuth client/Secret or Supabase callback change needed for Email.
email.registrationCaveat: Normal UI request defaults create_user=true; future QA must bind the exact existing B email and resulting immutable B Account ID. A new bundle does not authorize another registration.

currentSourceDefaults.GoogleConfiguration: googleSignIn.ts fixed original iOS/Web public Client IDs; no inspected email-only disable flag
currentSourceDefaults.GoogleUI: EmailOtpSignIn.tsx:146 shows Google before challenge; RNGoogleSignin/OtrGoogleSignIn capability can remain available in same compiled binary
currentSourceDefaults.GoogleScopeMeaning: Email-only QA scope may prohibit all Google actions, but cannot be described as app-level disabled from bundle rename, absent secret or URL removal alone. If capability-level disabling is required, Native must supply an existing qualified mechanism; this contract adds no flag/code/client.
currentSourceDefaults.URLConstraint: New QA package must omit old Google reversed URL registration and omit or independently register generic otrmobile deep-link scheme consistently with effective Expo config; no duplicate registration/routing to old apps. Email itself needs neither. Native owns actual Info.plist/URL handling proof.

storage.adapter: authRepository SecureStore get/set/delete pass no keychainService/accessGroup options
storage.secureStoreDependency: Source0e declares expo-secure-store~57.0.3; inspected installed iOS source defaults keychainService to app (auth/no-auth suffix); accessGroup added only if explicitly supplied. This is source evidence, not codesign/runtime isolation proof.
storage.nativeRequired: Effective signed application-identifier/AppIdentifierPrefix and accessible keychain groups must be the new independent identity, with no old/shared group; do not infer from CFBundleIdentifier. No old restore/backup/credential transfer.
storage.sqlite: openDatabaseAsync(otr-mobile.db), Guest openDatabaseAsync(otr-guest-<localId>.db); no custom directory/group in these callers. Same filenames are safe only when Native proves a distinct private app data container, no shared file group or copied/restored DB.
storage.guestRecovery: Existing app Documents/auth-guest-adoption/<guestLocalId> must likewise not be copied/shared.
storage.initialProof: After safe artifact/container binding, normal existing principal/empty-inventory/handoff qualification must actually pass before B login. No fresh-bundle/UI-empty inference. New launch can legitimately create Guest marker/schema; use original current-schema zero-data/draft/recovery qualification, never delete rows.

normalConfig.EXPO_PUBLIC_OTR_NATIVE_QA_SCOPE: absent/empty; nonempty expired/malformed or string false still quarantines and makes general gate false
normalConfig.EXPO_PUBLIC_OTR_DEV_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE: existing public DEV channel, value not read/exported here
normalConfig.constraint: These existing environment values must be evidenced in actual embedded JS/effective config, not just shell env or Info rename. Do not disable General gate or use old QA_SCOPE to fake normal My Trips entry.

binaryReuseNativeProofFields: Actual unique QA bundle/application identifier, signing identity and effective entitlements; no shared/old keychain or app group
Mach-O/native ABI/module hash provenance from0e compiled program; Native owner decides re-sign/repackage compatibility, Auth does not codesign/build attest
Complete actual main.jsbundle/update ID/hash and source/API/runtime config; effective embedded Expo config, Info URL schemes and appidentifier consistent
OTRFormsQAEmbeddedBundle true selects embedded main.jsbundle in existing AppDelegate plugin; prove actual selection and no unintended Metro/update artifact
Existing C0 device and exclusive lawful claim; new independent app data/keychain namespace, no old app launch/modification/backup import
Normal current-principal, empty Guest assets/drafts/recovery, and account DB/pending queue proof; current exact B-only login/read/cold scope

bootstrapReadOnlyBoundary.source: Account bootstrap opens/migrates normal DB, adoptLegacyAccountState, resumes operational sync; bootstrapActivatedAccount/reconnect/lifecycle also resume; normal cycle includes native manual queue, trip-create/metadata and Ledger queues
bootstrapReadOnlyBoundary.requiredActualGuard: Native must prove new private context has no migrated/seeded/unfinished outgoing queues and no business/source/provider action is eligible or triggered, and bind/observe approved normal Auth/bootstrap/read requests versus forbidden mutation endpoints. Existing selectors/guards remain authoritative; default normal bootstrap is not an automatic read-only guarantee. If guard/current queue state cannot be proved, keep execution unqualified. Do not clear old queues, add a flag, use old QA_SCOPE, or turn General gate off.
bootstrapReadOnlyBoundary.scope: B max normal OTP1/noresend when current authority allows; no A login/switch/POST/private fixture/Claim/Revoke/Provider/Source; normal Auth POSTs are not blanket-banned as business writes. Existing read-like bootstrap side effects need their owning current scope, not assumed from this contract.

actualQualification.ROLE: Current normal B identity/member permission pending actual qualifying run; historical Host proof only
actualQualification.Owner: Existing exact matching Native B scope may be reused only if actually supplied; otherwise one minimal scope request. This contract grants no install/OTP/device/identity authority.
actualQualification.Native: 0e binary reuse, exact QA identity/signature/URL/embeddedConfig/container/empty proof UNBOUND, Native DRI
actualQualification.shorterSafeContext: None currently verified in supplied metadata: old C0 126/149 are historical and unknown today; Guest14750 remains ineligible; do not guess or launch old app.
